review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — close.ts sets `risk` from the card and spreads `prompt_tokens` only when `promptTokens` finds a figure. history-cost.test.ts checks the largest figure (18,400 over 9,200), that the field is left out when no line has a figure, and that only build-started timeline lines are read.
- A2: met — `renderCost` lists id, cost and prompt tokens for low-risk rows over $1, and prints 'no low-risk task cost over $1' when there are none. Both cases are tested through `runMetrics`.
- A3: met — `costFlags` requires `risk === "low"`. A row with no risk and cost 12 is tested and not flagged.

<details><summary>2 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Cost just over $1 prints as $1.00 `packages/cli/src/commands/metrics.ts:93` — Round before comparing, e.g. `Math.round(r.cost_usd * 100) > 100`, or print more digits when the rounded value is 1.00.
- history.jsonl is read twice on the non-findings path `packages/cli/src/commands/metrics.ts:120` — Derive one from the other, or read the file once and pass it to both.

</details>

_Not reviewed: `packages/action/dist/SOURCE_SHA256` (generated), `packages/action/dist/index.js` (generated)._

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: Cost just over $1 prints as $1.00
suggestions.detail: `costFlags` uses `cost_usd > 1`, but `toFixed(2)` rounds. A flagged row can show `$1.00` under a header that says 'over $1', which reads as a false flag.
suggestions.repro: A history row with risk 'low' and cost_usd 1.004 is listed as `T-xxxx  $1.00  prompt tokens n/a`.
suggestions.fix: Round before comparing, e.g. `Math.round(r.cost_usd * 100) > 100`, or print more digits when the rounded value is 1.00.

suggestions.title: history.jsonl is read twice on the non-findings path
suggestions.detail: `historyRows(root)` is now read up front, and `loadHistory(root)` reads the same file again later. The two reads can disagree if a close lands in between, so `cost` and `history` would describe different snapshots.
suggestions.repro: Run `rivetari metrics` (without --findings) while a task close appends to history.jsonl.
suggestions.fix: Derive one from the other, or read the file once and pass it to both.

acceptance.note: close.ts sets `risk` from the card and spreads `prompt_tokens` only when `promptTokens` finds a figure. history-cost.test.ts checks the largest figure (18,400 over 9,200), that the field is left out when no line has a figure, and that only build-started timeline lines are read.
`renderCost` lists id, cost and prompt tokens for low-risk rows over $1, and prints 'no low-risk task cost over $1' when there are none. Both cases are tested through `runMetrics`.
`costFlags` requires `risk === "low"`. A row with no risk and cost 12 is tested and not flagged.
